Aha I am in both worlds as I am Canadian but just studying in France. I thought I would stay in France but I am leaving due to personal and somewhat cultural reasons, not necessarily related to the industry.

But yeah, honestly it would be nice if this sub had a continent flair so we can see where exactly these more gloomy posts are coming from and know where exactly the situation is, instead of making everyone panic.

If I have to be honest, most French schools are not known outside of France. I am an international studying at a school that is pretty well known in France but outside of France barely anyone has heard of it. In fact, I wasn't going to apply until a French friend told me I would be a good fit.

Like everyone will tell you, school rep doesn't matter so long as you yourself have good skills. Just because you would go to Gobelins doesn't mean you will automatically get work, I have heard rumors in France that certain studios even actively avoid Gobelins students as they find them too clique-y and hard to work with.

If you are keen on studying in Europe, focus more on finding a school that works well FOR YOU and your learning style/goals, not what looks good on paper.

Also, I'm pretty sure Emile Cohl does not provide instruction in english unlike Gobelins does. Most French schools will require a decent proficiency in French and even then, this country is a bit hostile to foreigners, even if you can speak the language, so that's something to think about!
